newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil falls further at close, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil falls further at close, seen mixed.

text.p: Palm oil prices in Malaysia fell further on Tuesday on technical selling and a lack of cash business as sentiment remained damp ahead of fresh crop estimates for August, traders said.
"People are throwing their positions as all July crop numbers are out," a trader said, adding that prices were expected to drop further before seeing a rebound.
Traders said the underlying tone was still firm as fundamentals were good.
They said the consolidation of the ringgit was still acceptable as it was in a position still regarded weak.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was stabilising at around $2.7850 against the dollar in Kuala Lumpur after trading at 2.7920 at 0200GMT.
Traders said the market was awaiting private crop forecaster Ivan Wong's report for late August, which was due sometime this week.
"We don't know what Ivan is going to estimate in his August crop data," a trader said. "That's one reason why people are selling."
Traders said exports for August were, however, expected to be as good as July, although Wong may predict a higher output.
Cargo surveyor SGS (M) Bhd Bhd, which projected Aug 1-15 exports at 312,757 tonnes, is due to make another estimate on Wednesday for exports during Aug 1-20.
SGS projected full July exports at 715,600 tonnes against the 622,210 in June.
All futures posted double-digit losses.
The third-month November futures contract closed 14 ringgit lower at 1,250 ringgit ($448) a tonne.
Traders said the contract could test a resistance of 1,300 ringgit.
In the physicals sector, scattered business was seen, with Aug (south) being offered at 1,285 ringgit against bids of 1,277.50, and Aug (central) offered at 1,260 against 1,250.
Sept (south) saw offers at 1,285 ringgit against bids of 1,280. Sept (central) was offered at 1,265 against 1,255
In refined palm oil, Sept RBD palm oil was offered at $487.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $487.50.
Sept RBD palm olein saw offers at $525, Oct/Nov/Dec at $520 and Jan/Feb/Mch at $520. Sept was traded at $526.
Sept RBD palm stearin was offered $360 a tonne, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $357.50. Aug/Sept RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $285. $1-2.7850 ringgit
